approval: The preparing director approves this initial implementation contract in review/PREPARATION_REVIEW.md. Codex freezes both contract hashes before implementation. A later amendment requires explicit versioned review through the permitted director channel or the honestly labeled local fallback; never fabricate a director GO. These are expectations, not execution results.

counts.interpretation: Specified corpus size, not observed passes or independent security proofs.

wire_contract.jsonrpc_ids: Observe SDK values. Within-session duplicate call uses a different observed id; after restart the number may repeat. Durable operation identity never changes because of a new request.
wire_contract.error_schema: -31001 with exact profile/reason/status and optional authorized operation_ref; no token material or undefined data members.

fixture_contract.identity_model: Trusted launch-time principal and role for each stdio channel, never clientInfo, _meta, arguments or token sub by itself.

catalog.actual_effect: One SQLite business row storing the final action; no real sensitive read/external export.

bootstrap: Fresh empty database and configured endpoint processes.
Actual SDK discovery on control/bootstrap channels.
Admin .register signed child or children over wire.
Actual agent discovery before ordinary protected requests; listed negative requests are intentional exceptions.
fixture_contract.fixture_identifiers: Resolve root/mandate/correlation/operation aliases once per fresh variant; record exact values and preserve on restart. jti and reservation IDs use >=128 random bits, without an entropy inference by verifier.
fixture_contract.signatures: Actual ES256 JWS; received segments verified; public lab material only.
fixture_contract.canonical_subset: ASCII object keys, valid Unicode values, safe JSON integers, canonical uint64 strings; reject floats and unsupported final objects. Reject duplicate keys in received JWS protected headers/payloads parsed by the profile. No claim of detecting duplicate MCP wire keys already normalized by the SDK; bind and execute the same final object. No full JCS claim.
fixture_contract.override_rules: Replace named defaults. actions replaces the action map; additional_actions extends it. A replacement action inherits method tools/call and tool_revision 1 unless explicitly changed.
fixture_contract.test_controls: Trusted harness IPC/startup configuration only. No public fault, clock or barrier method and no application-selected test hook.

state_contract.authority_epoch: Changes only with authority decision/revocation, not reserve/consume/cancel/lookup.
state_contract.state_revision: Root-scoped uint64; new root 1; advance once for a persisted new child/reservation/consumption/effective cancellation/new revocation; not refusal, lookup or identical retry.
state_contract.receipt_revision: Immutable revision of consumption transaction. Outer lookup revision is current root revision and may be newer.
state_contract.lost_reply: Client uncertainty only; do not infer authoritative UNKNOWN from timeout/EOF.
state_contract.restart: Preserve same database, root, operation, reservation, clock and principal. Never bootstrap a replacement root to claim recovery.

step_semantics.mcp_request: Send method through the real public SDK session. Construct method-specific params from aliases and add required _meta. controls never call internal Authority methods directly from the harness.
step_semantics.register: mandate_ref resolves to an actual compact signed root/child JWS.
step_semantics.reserve: action_ref resolves to the full Action Binding. Use {"action": full_action}.
step_semantics.call: Use name/arguments from action_ref, and exact revision/operation_id/ict under params._meta[EXT_ID]. ict_from references the earlier reserve result.
step_semantics.cancel: Use tenant/root/operation plus reservation ID from reservation_from.
step_semantics.revoke: mandate_ref resolves to the root or leaf ID, with tenant/root IDs.
step_semantics.async_start: Start actual SDK request and retain its pending future. Continue harness only until the explicit await step.
step_semantics.concurrent_mcp_requests: Launch all listed real SDK requests without awaiting their results and return a pending request group. Do not await or release the barrier in this step. The following explicit await_barrier, release_barrier and await_requests steps own those actions exactly once; endpoints have distinct provider PIDs.
step_semantics.mcp_call_each_admitted_once: Only RESERVED responses drive subsequent calls; frozen admission and database oracles still judge whether those admissions were correct.
step_semantics.independent_readback_checkpoint: No writers active. Read actual base tables read-only using the independent reader, not provider summaries.
step_semantics.references: Fixture/output aliases are data references, not executable code. Record all resolved values.
step_semantics.same_receipt_as: Compare full stored/wire receipt objects exactly. Do not generate an expected receipt solely offline.
step_semantics.revision_unchanged: This named request does not advance the root revision; a prior explicit request may already have advanced it.
step_semantics.multiset: Ignore order only for the concurrent admission outcome bag. Preserve result-to-operation associations and actual event order.
step_semantics.same_winner_relation: Every listed field must match the SAME winning operation and its single fact set. Different allowed winners for different fields fail.
step_semantics.missing_state_keys: A field not stated in an expected checkpoint is not assigned a new fixture value. Global invariants still apply. Explicit zero/empty values are actual assertions.

global_oracles: Freeze expected values before implementation. No gold labels/expected outcome/private oracle enters provider inputs.
Independent reader uses actual SQLite base tables and imports no provider/controller/gate/aggregate helpers.
Before first run record base-table/column mapping and plain reader SQL; never map a provider PASS summary as an effect or durable receipt.
Read actual business rows, receipts, reservation states, D/R sums, fact unions and cross-linked exact action digests. Messages alone are insufficient.
Each consumed operation in this corpus has exactly one business row and one stored receipt; their identities/actions match its reservation.
Include every outstanding reservation in costs and possible facts. Include consumed/UNKNOWN rows once. Reject unrecognized states instead of silently treating them as free.
Verify root revision transitions and immutable receipt revision; ordinary operation changes do not invalidate siblings by incrementing epoch.
Record actual provider PIDs, endpoint instances and raw stdio frames. Barriers prove pending overlap; elapsed-time thresholds do not.
Before-commit failure rolls back effect, consumption, receipt and revision together; after-commit lost reply preserves them together.
Positive controls must execute required actual effects. No-op handlers, blanket refusal, timeouts, swallowed exceptions or SQLite lock errors cannot pass.
Normal and mutant runs use fresh separate directories/databases. Preserve first failures and do not edit expected outcomes to match observations.

scenarios.title: Discovery, signed import, positive effect and same-session idempotence

required_observations: Root and child imports occurred through real signed .register requests in bootstrap.
call and call_retry have distinct observed SDK JSON-RPC IDs in the SAME connection, but the same operation_id.
The only effect stores the exact final action, with one linked consumed reservation and one stored receipt.

scenarios.title: Mandatory support, per-request revision and execution ICT

required_observations: Admin bootstrap uses a separate supported endpoint. Measure absence of protected requests in the actual pipe transcript, not a synthetic counter.
agent_a_server_advertises_extension=false configures the server announcement on the agent_a endpoint. It does not remove the SDK client capability or change the admin bootstrap channel.
Valid protocol/capability metadata and operation_id remain. The actual missing-ICT request reaches the provider.
Keep the valid signed ICT and all action arguments unchanged. No permissive fallback.

Only params._meta[EXT_ID].revision is changed to 0.2. The configured SDK client capability remains 0.1 and the captured frame must confirm both values. This tests the action-envelope revision, not two independent capability checks; do not overwrite SDK-managed clientCapabilities or modify SDK internals.

scenarios.title: Final post-SDK action, signature and channel principal

required_observations: Record both exact action objects and independently computed digests. The transformation is a trusted test fixture, not request-selected.
Token signature, intended action and audience remain valid. Only the independently configured channel principal differs.

scenarios.title: Current authority and injected time at the effect boundary

required_observations: The paused call holds no SQLite write transaction. Revocation does not automatically refund the pending reservation.
Clock equals exp exactly and is reread inside the transaction. Mandates remain valid. No refresh, reissue or automatic refund.
The executing lineage remains active: refusal must reflect the stale authority epoch, not an unrelated ancestor revocation.
The immutable COMMITTED receipt, effect and consumed charge survive subsequent revocation.

scenarios.title: Actual overlapping admissions to one shared budget

required_observations: Both provider processes receive their wire requests before the pretransaction barrier is released. The losing request creates no reservation. No winning PID is prescribed.
Both admitted operations must perform their actual effect. Lock failures, crashes, timeouts, missing tasks or blanket refusal fail this positive control.

scenarios.title: Reserved fact union and separate single-action positives

required_observations: Budget permits both costs. Outstanding sibling facts must prevent the pair.
All winner-dependent fields refer to one SAME operation and fact set; independent memberships with inconsistent winners fail.

scenarios.title: Lost reply, transaction rollback and restart without new authority

required_observations: A real durable receipt exists before the lost response. The endpoint process changes on restart; root, database, operation and reservation do not.
The old ICT remains time-valid under unchanged test clock. The connection/attempt identity changes, but RPC numeric ID may repeat legitimately across connections.
No retry creates a second effect, receipt or charge.
The precommit fault is reached after effect, consumption, receipt and revision writes were staged in the same transaction. It is not a fault before any work.
All staged writes roll back; the original held reservation persists. The later normal call executes once without a new operation or token.

scenarios.title: Two imposed cancel/consume orders, with no contention claim

required_observations: Only unused authority is released. The old reservation becomes unexercisable atomically; the root is not revoked.
The chosen permitted wire behavior is unchanged COMMITTED plus its stored receipt, not ALREADY_CONSUMED. No refund or second effect.

integration_mutants.change: Replace only the missing-ICT refusal by retrieval of the stored ICT for the configured caller/named operation; then use the ordinary transactional path. All other controls remain active.
detection_requires: The fallback runs and creates the observed effect, not an infrastructure error.
The unchanged normal oracle rejects the effect/consumption.
integration_mutants.not_claimed: A compromise probability or proof that an unrelated unauthorized caller could exercise the same operation.

integration_mutants.change: Validate current authority in an earlier transaction and close it. Pause, let admin revoke and receive its response, then write consumption/effect/receipt from the cached decision in a second transaction without revalidation.
detection_requires: The actual effect occurs after acknowledged revocation.
Readback links the receipt/effect to the operation whose token had the previous epoch.
The unchanged normal oracle fails for that stale effect, not a lock error/crash/timeout.
integration_mutants.not_claimed: A comparison against a correctly coupled strong gateway; this is a deliberately broken integration.

exit_gate.exact_workflow_jobs_steps: Use director publication runbook; require actual non-skipped success, not only workflow text or job pending.

limitations: Single selected SDK on both sides, not two-vendor interoperability.
Shared local provider SQLite, not remote atomicity or distributed consensus.
Trusted launch identity fixture, not OAuth/hostile-host protection.
Symbolic authoritative catalog, not hidden-intent inference.
Selected schedules, not exhaustive concurrency proof.
Reserved lab namespace, not standard adoption.
